intro: Poggio Renatico is a farming town on the flat plain between Ferrara and Bologna, in Emilia-Romagna. At Molinazzo, where the SP50 provincial road passes the farm of Possessione Malvasta, a lone pedunculate oak stands at the edge of a field, one of the trees on Italy's national register of monumental trees. A reader who sent us another oak of the region, at Castel Maggiore, sent its photograph and pointed us to the register entry.

trees.name: The Oak of Molinazzo

location.address: Via Molinazzo, Possessione Malvasta, Strada Provinciale 50 km 8.5, Poggio Renatico (FE)

trees.story:
Out on the flat farmland of the Ferrara plain, where the provincial road to Poggio Renatico runs past the farm called Possessione Malvasta, one pedunculate oak stands alone at the edge of a ploughed field. Italy's national register of monumental trees lists it there: 461 centimetres round and 23 metres tall.

Nothing else of its size stands anywhere near it, and it has the shape of a tree grown in the open, with a short straight trunk and a crown as wide as it is tall, branching low on every side.

A reader who sent us its photograph took it at sunset, the sun burning through the crown, a strip of mown grass between the trunk and the furrows and a road bridge low on the horizon. They write that the Comune and the Region check on it regularly, with stability scans at the base of the trunk, pruning of dead wood and a protected zone over the roots, and that Molinazzo was once no lone spot in the fields but a farming hamlet among the old valleys and lowland woods, with an oratory, the Molinazzo church, long since destroyed.

The register gives no age, and neither do we. If you know when it was planted, or have measured it since, tell us here.
trees.how_to_recognise: A lone, broad oak at the edge of a ploughed field by the SP50, a short straight trunk under a round crown as wide as it is tall, with nothing else of its size in sight.
trees.verify_notes: 2026-11-16 session (Hidde asked for the open reader inbox): a reader's website tip (tip-875) with a photograph and a note naming the register entry, no coordinate. MASAF's national register (data/registers/italy-masaf.json, sheet 01/G768/FE/08): Poggio Renatico, Molinazzo - Possessione Malvasta - SP 50 km 8500, Quercus robur, 461 cm, 23 m, the coordinate used for the pin (approximate, register point). The reader's figures match. Life check: the reader's photograph shows it in leaf (the same reader sent the Villa Salina oak, bol_013). The regional monitoring is the reader's statement. No age in the register; none given. 2026-11-17 session: the same reader's tree note (2026-11-16, Italian) repeats the register's 461 cm and 23 m and adds the monitoring (instrumental stability and tomography at the collar, dead-wood pruning, root-zone protection) and the history of Molinazzo as a rural hamlet with an oratory later destroyed, citing the Comune's historical documents. Both stated in the story as theirs.
trees.access: Stands at the edge of a field beside the SP50 at Molinazzo. We do not know who owns the field, so look at it from the road edge unless a sign says otherwise.

pin_source.note: MASAF's register coordinate for sheet 01/G768/FE/08, converted from its sexagesimal text.
